asset: truck tractor 4x2 (fictional brand), Track A1 working dimensions
frame: Blockout scene: 1 unit = 1 m, Z up, truck faces +Y, driver side (LHD) = -X, origin = ground under front axle centre. Unity axes are mapped at export (A3+).

status_legend.SOURCED: value or limit taken from a cited regulation/standard
status_legend.DERIVED: computed from SOURCED values (formula in note)
status_legend.WORKING_VALUE: class-typical value chosen by truck-artist from general knowledge of modern EU 4x2 tractors; to be checked against owner photos/measurements and docs/VEHICLE_REFERENCE_DATA.md (owned by vehicle-physics)

max_width_m.source: Council Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.2 (as amended by (EU) 2015/719): max width 2.55 m (2.60 m conditioned bodies)

max_height_m.source: Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.3: max height 4.00 m

max_artic_length_m.source: Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.1: articulated vehicle 16.50 m

semitrailer_front_swing_radius_m.source: Directive 96/53/EC, Annex I 1.6 (horizontal distance kingpin to any point of the semitrailer front)

cab_width_m.source: class-typical body width of EU long-haul cabs (leaves room for 2.55 m limit at wheels/fenders)

overall_height_m.source: high-roof sleeper, unladen; must stay <= max_height_m

wheelbase_m.source: brief: class range 3.6-3.8 m for 4x2 long-haul tractors

front_overhang_m.source: front axle to bumper face, class-typical 1.40-1.50 m; concept B (aero nose) uses 1.52 m

rear_overhang_m.source: rear axle to frame end, class-typical 0.8-0.9 m

overall_length_m.source: front_overhang + wheelbase + rear_overhang = 1.45 + 3.70 + 0.80 (brief range 5.9-6.1 m); measured per concept incl. lamps in docs/reports/visual/truck-A2/koncepcja-*_wymiary.json

cab_back_behind_front_axle_m.source: gives cab length ~2.35 m (bumper excluded) for a sleeper cab

cab_body_bottom_m.source: lower edge of cab shell above ground; clears tyre top (1.04 m loaded) with suspension travel

tyre_diameter_m.source: ETRTO designation: 22.5 in x 25.4 + 2 x 0.80 x 315 mm = 571.5 + 504 = 1075.5 mm (unloaded, nominal)

static_loaded_radius_m.source: ~93% of free radius 0.538 m; check against a tyre maker data sheet (ETRTO SLR) before A3

rim_flange_diameter_m.source: visible steel disc wheel 22.5x9.00; bead seat 571.5 mm (DERIVED) + flange

wheel_pcd_m.source: 10 studs on 335 mm PCD (ISO 4107 commercial-vehicle hub pattern) — verify standard text

rear_track_m.source: between dual-pair centres, class-typical 1.80-1.85 m; outer tyre edges = 2.48 m

dual_spacing_m.source: centre-to-centre of dual tyres on 22.5x9.00 rims

frame_width_outer_m.source: common EU heavy-truck frame width (~850 mm outer)

fifth_wheel_height_m.source: brief: 1.10-1.15 m for standard semitrailers (low-deck/mega ~0.91-0.95 m not targeted). ISO 1726 (50 mm kingpin / coupling interface) not opened (UNVERIFIED); no standard value for saddle height is claimed. Physics fifthWheel.position.y and trailer kingpinHeight follow this value (ADR 0014)

fifth_wheel_lead_m.source: kingpin ahead of rear axle, class-typical 0.4-0.7 m; final value from axle-load calc (vehicle-physics)

cab_mount_height_m.source: cab pitch/roll pivot = lower plane of cab shell on its mounts (= cab_body_bottom_m, above frame top 0.97 m); physics cab.mountCenter.y follows this (ADR 0014)

cab_mount_z_m.source: rear-axle-origin frame: wheelbase - cab_back_behind_front_axle + cab_length/2 = 3.70 - 0.95 + 2.35/2 = 3.925; physics cab.mountCenter.z follows this (ADR 0014)

driver_eye_point_m.source: x: seat centreline 0.55 m left of truck centre (LHD); y: ~0.9 m behind windscreen base; z: seat R-point ~1.87 m + 0.635 m (UNECE R46 ocular-point offset above R-point = 635 mm, SOURCED) — R-point height itself is WORKING_VALUE

mirror_head_outer_m.source: half-width to outer edge of class II mirror head (~0.30 m beyond cab side, mirror-to-mirror ~3.1 m); mirrors are not counted in the 2.55 m limit
